description: Source code for schema type parsing in PyTorch's JIT frontend, including type registration, parsing base and complex types, alias annotations, and device/gradient options.

classes.name: SchemaTypeParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing schema types, including base types, complex types, alias annotations, device and gradient options, and custom classes.

methods.name: parseBaseType
methods.description: Parses and returns a base type from the schema string.

methods.name: parseType
methods.description: Parses and returns a pair of fake and real types along with alias info.

methods.name: parseFakeAndRealType
methods.description: Parses and returns a tuple of fake type, real type, and alias info, handling complex nested types.

methods.name: parseAliasAnnotation
methods.description: Parses alias annotations in schema types.

methods.name: parseTensorDType
methods.description: Parses tensor data types from string identifiers.

methods.name: tryToParseDeviceType
methods.description: Attempts to parse device type specifications.

methods.name: tryToParseRequiresGrad
methods.description: Attempts to parse requires_grad boolean flag.

methods.name: parseRefinedTensor
methods.description: Parses detailed tensor type specifications including shape, device, and requires_grad.

methods.name: parseList
methods.description: Utility to parse comma-separated lists within specified delimiters.
